pages.title: Leptogenesis
pages.text: $(thing)Leptogenesis$()$(br2)Matter and antimatter should have annihilated perfectly. They did not: heavy neutrinos decayed out of equilibrium, unequally to leptons and antileptons, and sphalerons turned the excess into baryons - one in a billion. Unlocks the Baryon Asymmetry Crystal.

$(thing)Insight$(): 190$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Reheating, Neutrino Physics.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 8 Sterile Neutrino.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): How rare are baryons? Count the photons: a black-body gas at temperature T has, per unit volume, an integral over energy of E² times the Bose-Einstein occupation 1/(e^{E/k_BT} − 1), times the density of states for two polarisations, 1/π² (units ħ = c = 1). Write the number density of photons.
